newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 stable in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in slow late trading on Wednesday, with fresh enquiries from Singapore and the United States, dealers said.
"We expect to secure more deals later today following fresh enquiries from Singapore and the United States, but the offtakes are likely to be in small quantity," one Jakarta dealer said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices were at 55.75-56.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.50-55.75 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as at 55.00-55.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Dealers said March/April SIR20 was last sold at 55.55 U.S. cents/lb fob Jakarta late on Wednesday.
